text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: At long last, it's time for Taiki<n>Shuttle's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's been a long time comin'—ever<n>since the
moment I set foot in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And to top it off, I've got me a new<n>dream!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be Umamusume of the Year!<n>You best
believe I'll be puttin' in the<n>work to make that
happen!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You bet! I'll tear up the track and rise<n>to the top!
